feed.title: The LLM Residency
feed.subtitle: LLM Model Training Residency: from zero to serving. The full cycle, written down every week.

entry.title: Looking Inside a Transformer
entry.summary: Week 2. Attention, feed-forward blocks, and the residual stream, measured in place: one sentence GPT-2 can only finish by moving information between positions, and the layer where the answer arrives.

entry.title: Tokens, Context, and Embeddings
entry.summary: Week 1. How text becomes token ids and vectors, measured on four sentences: one word, two senses, three representations. Ships with the Tokenizer Playground, GPT-2's tokenizer running in the browser.

entry.title: The Map of the Territory
entry.summary: Week 0 · Part A. A practical map of the LLM lifecycle, plus a character-level language model with held-out evaluation that runs on a laptop CPU.
